title: Question 19
passage:
Let’s buy stickier tape so these masking strips come off in one piece.
A. I put the spare rolls on the shelf. B. I cut them all to the same length. C. The paper tears before the adhesive lets go.
passageZh:
我們買黏性更強的膠帶，這樣遮蔽膠帶就能整條撕下來。
A. 我把備用膠帶捲放在架子上了。
B. 我把每條膠帶都剪成一樣長了。
C. 黏膠還沒鬆開，紙就先撕裂了。
